description: AI-generated illustrative scene, not a photograph of an actual client workshop.
prompt:
Edit the supplied workshop photograph illustration. Change only Max, the central man in the white crewneck sweater, to communicate a quieter, grounded way of listening. His current face/likeness is accepted: preserve his recognizable facial features, proportions, blue glasses, hair and white sweater.

The emotional direction is VIEW: vulnerability, impartiality, empathy and wonder. Translate that into subtle, believable photographic body language, not theatrical emotion:
- He stays comfortably centered in his own body while listening to the woman in the rust-red sweater on the left.
- Let his weight settle back onto the seat. Bring his torso more upright over his hips and his head back over his spine. He is no longer craning or leaning toward her.
- Drop and soften the shoulders, release tension in the neck and jaw, let the chest rest naturally.
- Let his hands rest loosely and comfortably in his lap or on his thighs, fingers unforced.
- Keep gentle eye contact with the woman, but soften the eyes and brow. His gaze is receptive and spacious, not intensely focused, analytical, stern or penetrating.
- A very slight, unforced warmth at the corners of the mouth is fine. No broad grin, no staged smile, no exaggerated empathetic head tilt, no pursed lips.
He looks quietly curious, open to being surprised, at ease with himself and giving the speaker room. A human being listening without trying to fix, persuade or pull something out of her. Calm, present and approachable, not detached or sleepy.

Preserve his face identity rather than creating another person. You may adjust his posture, hands, head angle and facial expression enough to achieve this natural grounded quality. Keep plausible anatomy and seated proportions.

Keep the woman in red and the other three participants, their positions and gestures, the chairs, room, lighting, colors, camera angle and composition unchanged. Keep Max's white sweater and jeans. Photorealistic candid texture, no retouching or stylization, no text or logos. Same opaque landscape 3:2 format.
